API Courier — original prototype assets

Original robot artwork, separate transparent PNG parts, and an authored Spine 4.2-format JSON rig. Import courier.json using Spine Import Data, with images in the same folder. Animations: idle, walk, wait, celebrate. This JSON has not been verified in the Spine Editor; no native .spine project is supplied.

The live prototype uses an independent Canvas renderer for these simple region attachments and bone timelines. It does not include the proprietary Spine runtime. Official runtime integration requires an appropriate Spine license.

You may use and modify this original artwork and rig in your projects.
